in_hebrew.name: Marillin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mary's shining star
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marillin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A name derived from the Greek word 'Mary' and 'linos' meaning 'shining, radiant'. This name symbolizes the star that shone over the birthplace of Jesus, signifying the arrival of the Messiah.

in_greek.name: Marillin

This name symbolizes the star that shone over the birthplace of Jesus, signifying the arrival of the Messiah.

in_latin.name: Marillin
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mary's shining star
in_latin.long_meaning: Marillin est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. A name derived from the Greek word 'Mary' and 'linos' meaning 'shining, radiant'. This name symbolizes the star that shone over the birthplace of Jesus, signifying the arrival of the Messiah.
